devdoc.details: The accrual is simulated and openly so — nothing here should be mistaken for a return.         Every number the app shows that originates here is labelled as simulated. Swapping in         the Morpho adapter changes this contract and nothing else.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

accruedYield().details: Accrues against the reserve rather than deployed principal. On Sepolia the pool's         principal stays wrapped as cUSD and is never handed to a venue, so there is no         real position to earn on — the reserve is the whole simulation. A live adapter         would accrue on {totalAssets} instead.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: MockYieldSource

accruedYield().notice: Yield earned since the last settle point, capped by what the reserve can pay.

asset().notice: The ERC-20 this source accepts and pays out in.

deposit(uint256).notice: Supply `amount` of `asset`, pulled from the caller.

fund(uint256).notice: Top the reserve up so draws keep paying. Owner pulls from their own balance.

harvest().notice: Send all accrued yield to the caller and return how much moved.

pool().notice: Only the pool may move principal in and out.

rateBps().notice: Simulated annual rate, in basis points.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Redeem `amount` of principal back to the caller.

userdoc.notice: Stands in for a real venue on Sepolia, where none exists. Accrues at a fixed rate         against a reserve the owner funds up front, so a draw has something to pay out.
